---
title: "Metrics"
---

## Marker-level metrics

- **PIP Brier score:** mean squared error between posterior inclusion probability and binary causal truth.
- **Effect RMSE:** root mean squared error of posterior-mean marker effects.
- **Average precision:** mean precision at causal-marker ranks after sorting by decreasing PIP.
- **Causal-marker ranks:** best, median, mean and worst one-based causal rank.
- **Top-K causal recall:** fraction of causal markers among the top 10, 20 and 50 PIP-ranked markers.

PIP ties are resolved by first occurrence in canonical marker order.

## Credible-set metrics

- Number of constructed credible sets.
- Mean and median set size.
- Conditional exact causal coverage.
- Conditional LD-proxy coverage at the configured threshold.
- Number of causal loci detected.
- Sets without exact causal markers.
- Sets without causal markers or qualifying proxies.

> **Conditional credible-set coverage**  
> Among constructed sets, how many contain the truth?

> **Causal-locus detection**  
> Among all true causal loci, how many generated a credible set?

These are cumulative marginal-PIP credible sets. They are not guaranteed per-effect credible sets or complete causal configurations.
